title: Avila Core Capability Selection v0.1 draft
description: The organization's recorded decision of which capability implementation serves each workflow step (ADR-0020, SC-8). The engine does not perform selection — it verifies the recorded one: every considered candidate carries a decision and reasons, the criteria applied come from a closed legitimate vocabulary, the selected candidate must be exactly the capability the manifest binds, and the disclosures the contract's execution_policy demands (Avila-provided, self-preference check, cost estimate and confirmation) are present. A refusal stops the run at bind/plan time and never enters a verdict.

registry_snapshot.description: The exact registry snapshot the candidates were discovered against — must equal the package's bound registry document.

query.description: How candidates were found — data, never interpreted.

candidates.description: Every candidate considered; at most one carries decision `selected`, and none may lack a recorded decision (SC-8.6).

criteria.description: The ordered criteria applied — closed vocabulary: cost, time, locality, technical, diversity, preference. provider_payment and avila_margin may never appear (CORE-P5601).

avila_provided.description: Whether the selected implementation is Avila-provided (SC-8.7).

self_preference_check.description: The self-preference check applied — required when avila_provided and execution_policy.forbid_self_preference is declared (CORE-P5501).

cost_estimate.description: The recorded cost estimate for the selected candidate — required when the contract declares a cost_cap so the cap can be checked (CORE-P5401).

cost_confirmed_by.description: Who confirmed a cost above the cap — the recorded human datum.

candidate.description: One considered implementation: the same identity the manifest binds — capability type, capability id, adapter, and executable digest.

decision.description: selected for at most one candidate; excluded for one ruled out by a stated reason; inadmissible for one that fails policy.

reasons.description: Why this decision — each reason carries a rule id and a fact. An empty list is a CORE-P5602 refusal.
